# Vaibhav Rajput — Portfolio Overview

> Full-Stack Software Developer & Electronics and Communication Engineering Student at ABES Engineering College.

## Summary
Vaibhav is a developer specializing in full-stack web software systems (React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL) and hardware/IoT integration (ESP8266, C++, sensor telemetry).

## Key Projects
- **Theiakshi HRMS**: Enterprise Human Resource & Attendance Management System built with React, Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL featuring biometric regularization workflows and RBAC permissions. (Repository: https://github.com/x-vaibhav/Theiakshi-One)
- **Solar Defect Detection**: IoT real-time fault monitoring system for solar PV panels using ESP8266 microcontrollers and threshold logic. (Repository: https://github.com/x-vaibhav/solar-defect-detection)
- **Fitzone Gym System**: Full-stack gym membership platform with class scheduling and administrative dashboard. (Repository: https://github.com/x-vaibhav/fitzone-gym)
- **PhonePe UI Clone**: High-fidelity pixel-perfect React replica of the PhonePe landing page focused on UI layout precision. (Repository: https://github.com/x-vaibhav/phonepe-clone)
- **ArduMist Hackathon**: Smart automated greenhouse micro-climate solution built using Arduino during a 24-hour hackathon.

## Technical Skills
- **Frontend**: React, TypeScript, Modern CSS3, HTML5, Layout Design
- **Backend & DB**: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, SQL Schema Migrations
- **DevOps & Tools**: Docker, Nginx, Git, Vite, Linux
- **IoT & Embedded**: ESP8266 / ESP32, Arduino C++, Circuit Prototyping, Telemetry

## Academic Background
- **Bachelor of Technology in Electronics & Communication Engineering**
  - Institution: ABES Engineering College (Expected 2026)
